title: Purchase Orders
rotateTitle: ↻ Rotate your phone horizontally to view the table
rotateBody: The Excel-style table requires a landscape orientation. Please rotate your phone to see all columns, zoom controls, and search.
noApprovedQuotations: No approved quotations for this vendor
paymentTypeHelp: Controls when payment happens and whether a gate pass needs an invoice
ptAfterOpt: After Delivery — pay after goods arrive + invoice
ptFullOpt: Against Full Payment — full payment done, goods follow
budgetHeadHelp: Tag this PO to a budget head for commitment tracking
itemDescPlaceholder: Optional item description for this PO (shown highlighted in PDF)
noDeductions: No deductions. Add TDS, retention, advance adjustment, or other deductions to reduce the net payable.
approvedPopupTitle: Your Purchase Order {{n}} has been APPROVED!
approvedPopupNote: You can now create a Gate Pass for this PO.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete purchase order {{n}}?
deleteNote: This action cannot be undone. Only purchase orders that are not approved, partially delivered, or delivered can be deleted.
deactivateConfirm: Are you sure you want to deactivate purchase order {{n}}?
deactivateNote: This will mark the PO as DELETED. It will no longer appear in the active PO list or Action Required. The record remains in the database for audit purposes.
editAfterApprovalNote: Only the Item Description and Referred By can be edited after approval. Financial details cannot be modified.
moveInfo: This will move {{amount}} from the current budget head "{{from}}" to the new one. The old head gets its money back; the new head is charged.
reasonBudgetPlaceholder: Why is the budget head being changed?
selectItemPost: Select the item to post to a ledger.
noGrn: No Goods Receipt created yet for this gate pass. The material has arrived at the gate but has not been inspected or posted to inventory.
noAssets: No individual asset records generated from this PO.
errSelectItem: At least one item must be selected
partialWarn: This PO was partially delivered. Edit quantities to match what was actually received. The PO will go for re-approval. After re-approval, a "Generate Regenerated PO" button will appear for the remaining items.
chipRegen: {{n}} item(s) will be available for regeneration
editReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Vendor delivered 70 out of 100, closing PO at delivered quantity
changePtInfo: Changing the payment type sends the PO back for re-approval. Once approved again, it is treated as the new type.
alertApproved: This PO is already approved. Saving changes returns it to Pending Re-Approval — it must be approved again before it counts as approved. Payment type is fixed at creation.
alertNotApproved: This PO has not been approved yet. You can edit items, payment terms, delivery date, and budget head. Payment type is fixed at creation and cannot be changed. The PO will remain pending approval after saving.
itemDescPlaceholder3: Item description for this PO (shown in the table and PDF)
regenInfo: This will create a new PO with the remaining items from the original PO. The new PO will need its own approval.
refPlaceholder: Select a user or type a new name
